officialParameters.label: FLICK
officialParameters.limitation: Source-aware finalized forward loop playback in shared Track FX A only; recording, overdubbing and LIVE pitch/reverse processing are not supported. Bare streaming DSP rejects these controls.

officialParameters.label: CARRIER
officialParameters.limitation: TRACK1-5 only, finalized Playing pre-FX/pre-LIVE-pitch source, same-block read-only tap. Empty/stopped/recording/overdub/pitch-conflicted/pinned sources are silent. Physical MIC/INST sources and CARRIER THRU are unsupported.
